howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.sub: Three steps. Zero phone calls. Zero repeated forms.

steps.title: Answer once
steps.text: A five-step wizard — location, drivers, vehicle, coverage, contact — with smart defaults and inline help. Your progress saves automatically.

steps.title: We ask everyone
steps.text: QuotePilot pings every relevant carrier for your state in the background while you watch live progress. Nobody is left out.

steps.title: Compare and pick
steps.text: Quotes arrive ranked by price with coverage-match scores, expandable details, a side-by-side compare view, and an emailed copy.

faq.heading: Questions, answered
faq.sub: The honest version — including what's simulated and what isn't.

items.a: You fill out one short form — location, drivers, vehicle, coverage, and contact. QuotePilot then asks every relevant carrier for your state to price that exact profile, and shows the results ranked side by side. When everything is in, we email you a copy too.

No. This demo build shows simulated pricing in realistic bands anchored to real Massachusetts quote research (for example, Allstate quoted $1,347 / 6 months for our sample profile in October 2026). Every quote card carries a 'Simulated — demo pricing' badge so it's always clear.

items.q: Which states and carriers are supported?
items.fallback: Massachusetts is fully seeded with direct and agent-only carriers, plus a local agent directory. Texas is fully seeded too — online carriers plus a Denton-area agent directory. Starter lists exist for NH and CA. Unknown states degrade gracefully — you'll get a clean empty state, not an error.
items.dynamicSuffix: , plus agent-only carriers through the local agent directory. Texas is fully seeded too — online carriers plus a Denton-area agent directory. Starter lists exist for NH and CA. Unknown states degrade gracefully — you'll get a clean empty state, not an error.

items.q: What happens to my personal information?
items.a: Nothing leaves the demo. Your wizard answers are saved only in your browser (localStorage) so you can resume where you left off. We never log PII, never sell data, and analytics events carry only anonymous metadata — no names, emails, or addresses.

Carriers respond at their own pace, so quoting runs as a background job. You'll see live progress ('4 of 6 carriers'), and most demo runs complete in under a minute. You can leave and come back — the job link keeps working.

finalCta.heading: Ready to see your number?
finalCta.sub: Two minutes now could save you hundreds on your next six months.
